items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The same minister that George Wilson went to church with married us.

ctx.x: Well we married. We married after that escapade I told you about with Cab Calloway and my mother coming down to Indianapolis, Indiana. We got married in Cincinnati. The same minister that George Wilson went to church with married us. We were deeply in love. It was amazingly. Mona was so… I can‟t tell you too much about her… I can‟t tell you enough.
I mean she‟s a pretty lady but other then that, what attracted her to you?
